The Topology Auditor found a clean mask, ruling out major fragmentation or floating parts. The only alignment uncertainty lies in the feet, which are partially obscured, but no contradictory features (like webbed feet) are visible.

The background blur is uniform and artificial. The high 'artifact risk' from the pose auditor is largely attributed to domain shift (AI style vs real photo training data) given the visual correctness of the head, but the limb uncertainty reinforces the visual ambiguity of the feet. These are minor structural/textural flaws, not catastrophic failures.
